text: Figure 7.17: Serialization based on the ImplementationDataTypes The actual steps that need to be performed at runtime are presented in Figure 7.18 and they are as follows: 1. Application of the sending software component provides the data to be transmit- ted to the RTE and stores it in SWC internal buffer. 2. If SwBaseType defined by the ImplementationDataType on the Port- Prototype of the SwComponentPrototype that is typed by Application- SwComponentType is different then the one defined by the Implementation- DataType on the PortPrototype of the RootSwCompositionPrototype, the RTE performs type conversion, and scaling if CompuMethods are also de- fined on these PortPrototypes, and stores the values internally in the RTE. 3. As no network representation is provided, the internal value from step 2 is used for the serialization and transmission on the bus. 4.
